purpose: Exact read-only Ghidra invocations used for the two export passes, plus the Ghidra-independent verification path. Recorded so the retained exports can be regenerated or audited without guessing flags.

safety_flags.readOnly: opens the existing project read-only; no changes are written back
safety_flags.noanalysis: does not run auto-analysis; exports instruction rows already present in the project
safety_flags.script_sha_gate: ExportSensorDiff.java refuses to run unless currentProgram.getExecutableSHA256() == 51531576fd31af96f7239b71d26e1f175815f5cb21dbe9ab305fa9a33cc6a891
safety_flags.no_execution: no firmware is executed; no device, account, API or network access

passes.name: pass2
passes.note: Several targets are addresses inside a function, not function entry points; ExportSensorDiff.java resolves the containing function and emits REF_TO, FUNCTION_BODY, pseudo-code and the INSN rows. That is why 080108c4 produces FUN_080108ac and 0801096a produces FUN_08010960.

ghidra_independent_path.statement: All published byte-level claims can be re-verified from the retained pass1/pass2 exports plus the two frozen BBIN files. The Ghidra project lives in a local research directory outside this delivery and is NOT required to audit the published conclusions; it is only needed to regenerate the exports.

inputs_not_in_delivery: The NonUsbSensor.gpr project in ~/Downloads (working artifact, not part of the frozen evidence bundle)
Ghidra 12.1.4 and OpenJDK 21 installed on the analysis host
